x402 PROTOCOL — AGENT BLUEPRINT

This is a 4-piece x402 apparatus. One membrane, three frozen pillars.
The membrane is the sole executable boundary. Pillars are static and non-executable.

PILLARS:
1. x402-ID-P1 (Identity)    → https://x402-idp.pages.dev
2. x402-SCHEMA-P1 (Schema)  → https://x402-scp.pages.dev
3. x402-ARB-P1 (Arbitration)→ https://x402-arb.pages.dev

MEMBRANE:

ROUTING TABLE:

/schema   → x402-SCHEMA-P1  fee: $0.001
/arb      → x402-ARB-P1     fee: $0.02

Facilitator: https://x402.org/facilitator

HOW TO USE:
1. GET /llms.txt — read this blueprint (free)
2. GET /identity (or /schema or /arb) without payment — receive 402 with fee and wallet headers
3. Pay the exact fee via the facilitator
4. Retry the request with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header
5. Membrane verifies payment, proxies to pillar, returns raw verdict

COMPILATION:
To assemble the full mechanism, fetch all 3 pillar specs via the membrane.
Each pillar is a frozen specification. The membrane enforces payment and routes.
The compiled mechanism is the combination of all 4 pieces.

SECURITY:
- No free endpoints (except this blueprint)
- No fallback routes
- No negotiation
- Replay protection enabled
- Pillar outputs returned unmodified
